newsitem.title: EGYPT: Iran's third submarine at mouth of Suez Canal.
newsitem.headline: Iran's third submarine at mouth of Suez Canal.

text.p: A Russian-made submarine has arrived at the mouth of the Suez Canal on its way to join the Iranian naval forces, shipping sources said on Wednesday.

The Kilo-class, diesel-powered submarine, the third and last vessel of its kind Tehran buys from Moscow, and an accompanying ship arrived at Port Said on Tuesday and were expected to enter the canal on Thursday or Friday, the sources said.
Iran is the only Gulf state to deploy submarines in the region which sits on about 70 percent of world oil reserves.

Western diplomats have said the United States and Iran's Gulf Arab neighbours were closely watching to see when Iran would deploy the submarine, which can lay mines and shoot torpedoes in the world's largest oil-exporting shipping lane.
Washington and Tehran's neighbours have voiced concerns over Iran's rearmament programme, which Tehran launched after its arsenal was depleted in the 1980-88 war with Iraq.
A U.S. official in the region has said he did not see the expected arrival of the submarine as an increase in Iran's capability "but just an increase in the size of its naval forces".
The United Sates has two submarines in the area.
